method: Chromium, 390x844, Spanish, isolated empty-library HTTP fixture, fresh contexts per screen, then same-context reload. Service worker blocked to separate HTTP cache; no interception ; network conditions recorded separately. Resource Timing transferSize includes response overhead; zero indicates HTTP cache. ready_ms is local lab navigation-to-visible-UI, not device or Internet latency.
